response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS af FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS b FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), st AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(af) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(a.af) AS avg_site_faces, AVG(a.af - base.b) AS avg_diff_from_baseline, AVG(a.af - st.sa) AS avg_diff_from_status FROM site_avg a JOIN st ON st.entrystat = a.entrystat CROSS JOIN base WHERE base.b IS NOT NULL AND a.af > st.sa

assumptions.assumption: The overall baseline is the average of facetfaces over all matched scanmesh rows (row-level), including rows for sites with NULL entrystat, rather than an average of site averages.
Only sites with at least one matching scanmesh row and at least one non-null facetfaces value have a site average; others are excluded.
A site with no recorded access status means entrystat IS NULL; these sites count toward the baseline but are excluded from status averages and the kept set.

alternatives.interpretation: The baseline is the simple average of all matched sites' averages (each site weighted equally, including sites with NULL entrystat), instead of the row-level average.
